messages:
maria_fin: Morning — we have an unexpected spike in eu-west GPU billing overnight (~€2.6k above expected). Looks correlated with spot preemptions and autoscaler fallback. Posting the short summary and asking ops/eng for recs.

dave_cloud: Seen it. Autoscaler logs show repeated drain events between 01:40Z-03:10Z; fallback_count=78. Affected jobs included long-running evals that retried immediately.

sophia_engineer: Those evals from personalization had retry_policy=immediate and max_retries=4. We should move to exponential backoff and add jitter.

eli_support: Affected customer-facing sandbox sessions were also moved to on-demand, causing higher per-hour rates. We need to decide whether to credit internal teams or eat from the platform contingency.

maria_fin: Quick cost breakdown (from billing table): personalization €1,400, search €700, sandbox €500. Total delta €2,600. Thoughts on credit policy?

dave_cloud: For consistency with prior incidents, propose auto-credit 50% of incremental cost to teams when preemptions>50 in a 2h window and fallback=true. Platform absorbs rest. This also incentivizes fixing retries.

sophia_engineer: 50% seems fair. We'll push job-template changes today and publish guidance.

eli_support: Please DM teams with the exact adjustments. Also include a note in invoice line: "partial platform credit - spot fallback".

maria_fin: Okay — approving 50% credit. I'll create the adjustment and split pro-rata by incremental GPU-hours. @dave_cloud and @eli_support please confirm approval.

dave_cloud: Approve. ✅

eli_support: Approve. ✅

maria_fin: Filing now. billing-bot: please open ticket and post link.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-5016. Credited amount: €1,300. Postmortem draft: https://internal.docs/postmortems/BILL-5016-spot-fallback.

maria_fin: Action items: (1) Eng to update retry templates (owner: sophia_engineer), (2) Platform to adjust autoscaler cooldown to reduce fallbacks (owner: dave_cloud), (3) Finance to update playbook to codify the 50% rule (owner: maria_fin). Closing thread once DM sent. Thanks all!
